name: Folclore Brasileiro
description: Creatures from Brazilian folklore come to Minecraft: the Saci, the Curupira, the Boitatá, the Headless Mule, the Iara, the Boto, the Cuca, the Lobisomem and the Mapinguari, each with the rules of its legend. / Criaturas do folclore brasileiro no Minecraft, cada uma com as regras da sua lenda.
